changelog:
# CHANGELOG for firmware release v139 — target esp32c3
## ✨ New Features
* Added support for Matter protocol on ESP32C3 devices
* Implemented Wi-Fi provisioning using esp-idf framework
* Enhanced device discovery for improved connectivity

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
* Fixed issue with repeated device restarts due to Wi-Fi connection loss
* Resolved bug causing incorrect reporting of device battery levels
* Corrected issue with device failing to connect to Matter network

## 🔐 Security
* Identified 1 secret in the codebase, which will be addressed in the next release
* No critical CVEs detected in this release
* Security score remains at 0/10, indicating a need for improvement

## ⚡ Performance
* Optimized flash usage, currently at 43.9% of total capacity
* Potential saving of 95 KB identified for future optimization
* No significant performance enhancements in this release

## 🔍 Code Quality
* Generated 4 tests to improve code coverage and quality
* No AI patches applied in this release
* Code quality remains a focus area for future releases

## ✅ Quality Gates
* Build process completed successfully
* No patches applied in this release
* Quality gates passed, but security score remains a concern

## ⚠️ Known Issues
* Security score of 0/10 indicates a high risk of security vulnerabilities
* Presence of 1 secret in the codebase poses a security risk
* Device may still experience connectivity issues in certain scenarios

## 🔜 Next Release
* Address the identified secret and improve security score
* Apply AI patches to enhance code quality and security
* Focus on optimizing flash usage and improving overall performance
